references.text: Warning against turning away to serve and worship other gods
Refers to gods that neither they nor their fathers knew
Prohibition against going away to serve and worship other gods
Israel sacrificed to gods they did not know, new gods who had recently arrived
Their fathers served other gods on the other side of the river
Israel abandoned the Lord their God and served Baal and Ashtoreth
Prohibition against worshipping other gods, bowing down to them or serving them
Explanation of why the Lord allowed disaster to come upon the people: they abandoned him and worshipped other gods
Judah's evil in turning away and burning incense to other gods they did not know
